## What and why

## Checklist

- [ ] Mathematical behaviour has tests (expected values, negative cases, assumption cases)
- [ ] Unsupported or unverified cases return an explicit status; no plausible-looking fallback
- [ ] `ruff`, `mypy`, `pytest`, `python -m minerva_knowledge verify`, `pnpm lint typecheck test` pass
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, infrastructure details or copied copyrighted text
- [ ] New dependencies are permissively licensed and justified (see `docs/licensing.md`)
- [ ] Docs / CLAUDE.md updated if commands or architecture changed
